pages.text: $(thing)Clubroot$() ($(o)Plasmodiophora brassicae$()), protist.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() brassicaceae.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, mechanical contact.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 13-30 °C (best 23 °C), pH below 7.2.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 15 years (resting spores in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 80% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Lime to pH 7.2 or higher; Long rotation away from brassicas; Clean soil off boots and tools; Resistant varieties.
Resting spores survive in soil for 15 years or more; liming is the classic control.
